VPP install reap timeout
fields.help: Minimum time a stuck App Store or in-house app install must have been activated before Fleet fails it to release the host's activity queue. Zero or less turns the reaper off, and a value below the VPP verify timeout is raised to it.

fields.label: Script results retention
fields.help: Minimum time since a script run recorded its result before the hourly cleanup deletes it. Runs still waiting on a host, and those that locking, wiping, unlocking, setup experience, software uninstalls or batch runs depend on, are kept regardless. 0 disables the cleanup.

fields.label: Software install results retention
fields.help: Minimum time since a software install or uninstall finished before the hourly cleanup deletes its record. Records a host is still working on, those setup experience depends on, and the most recent install and uninstall per host and package, are kept regardless. 0 disables the cleanup.

fields.label: Allow request certificate from any IdP

Config ETags
fields.help: Enable conditional osquery config requests: agents that send an ETag receive the minimal 'unchanged' body when their config is current. While off, every response is the full config with no ETag.

fields.label: Redis config ETags
fields.help: Answer osquery config requests whose ETag matches from a Redis-backed ETag store, skipping the config build and its database reads. Requires Redis and also requires config ETags to be enabled.

fields.label: Config in-memory cache
fields.help: Cache the scheduled-report section of the osquery config in memory, keyed by fleet and the query reports disabled setting, instead of rebuilding it from the database on every check-in. The rest of the response is never cached.

fields.label: Max concurrent query report reads
fields.help: Maximum number of osquery log requests per Fleet server that read a host's stored report results from the database at once, to skip writing unchanged results. Requests over the limit skip storing report results. 0 disables the limit.

fields.label: Max concurrent query report writes
fields.help: Maximum number of osquery log requests across all Fleet servers that write changed report results to the database at once. Requests over the limit skip storing their changed results. 0 disables the limit.
